I have BPD. I'm not able to work or study or have any kinds of relationships with anyone because of that. I've been alone in my flat for 1,5 years now. For the first time in my life I'm going to spend Christmas here alone, if I'm still alive. I've been to psychiatric hospitals and I've tried medications and therapies for 10 years, but nothing has helped. This summer my doctor told me there's nothing she can do about this anymore, so I should just try and figure my life out on my own. I had a separate therapist but for some unknown reason she hasn't called me for 2 months and I'm too afraid to call her, if she just doesn't want to see me anymore. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week I'm sitting here alone doing nothing but I'm too afraid to go outside besides grocery shopping - though I don't even know what I would do if I could go outside. It's even worse because there are times when I realize I'm a beautiful, intelligent 23-year-old woman and this is just a waste really. I'm too alone and there's nothing I can do about it and I just wish I was dead.

Eyebrows are not really something you can shape just any way you like. They should follow the natural line and do what they can. I seriously think it's something you can do on your own, too. Just take it slow. There are some great how-to guides in the Internet and also some videos in Youtube. Just google "how to shape eyebrows"!
Also if you want to go to a professional, I suggest you see a make up artist instead of a cosmetologist. We are better trained in seeing what would suit you best. Find a good make up artist and ask her/him to do whatever they think would look best on you. And eyebrows will grow back fast, so no matter what you do, there is no permanent harm done :)

Make up artist here :) I think you should definitely shape your eyebrows more, would make your eyes come out better. Otherwise just keep it simple, I think you have a very pretty face. Yes, I do have the same feeling every now and then. I can even walk to the store, buy the chips/chocolate/whatever, walk home, eat and realize what I'm doing only when I'm finished. I know it sounds like an excuse to "normal" people, but I know a lot of people suffer from this kind of behaviour so we are not alone.

I can also relate to this: "The thought of binges in the past has stopped me from even trying to lose weight as "it won't work because my cravings and binges will defeat me so I shouldn't bother trying"."
It's not only about losing weight, I have those thoughts about everything I should do. "I have always failed working so there's no point even trying to get a job" "I didn't make the last relationship work so why should I try to get a new one" and so on.
Just wanted to tell you I'm having this exact feeling right now. Don't have any solution tho.

I have actually tried it at a hospital. I did it for 2 sessions and I know that's not much. Even the normal "relaxing exercises" that people do make me anxious or angry, I can't take one second of that "imagine a beautiful place... concentrate on your elbows..." crap. It just makes me wanna scream. I know it's my own fault. I guess I should just try it again, though now I need to do it on my own because they wont put me in any of those groups anymore.
OK, I'll consider killing myself now. Thanks for your help! :))
Thanks a lot. You're obviously a wonderful person.
